name: currency_converter
description: Converts amounts between fiat currencies using free ECB exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.dev). No API key required.

from_currency.description: ISO 4217 source currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

to_currency.description: ISO 4217 target currency code (e.g. INR, JPY, CAD)
